description.en: Planned fossil-form study featuring small regular initial coil becomes an irregular free tubular shell.
description.zh: 拟议化石形态研究：初始小规则盘卷逐渐成为不规则自由壳管。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level planning concept with a named morphological source; inferred anatomy and artistic simplification are separate from observed fossil form.
scientific_scope.zh: 具有具名形态来源的属级规划方案；推断解剖和美术简化须与化石可见形态分开。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is small regular initial coil becomes an irregular free tubular shell; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以初始小规则盘卷逐渐成为不规则自由壳管为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish small regular initial coil becomes an irregular free tubular shell in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以初始小规则盘卷逐渐成为不规则自由壳管搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: Anchor the fossil study to Pliocene V. recta. Use one coiled-to-uncoiled shell, not an extra colony-density variant or an unmarked living species.
reference_notes: Period is representative, not a full range or a coexistence claim. Anchor the fossil study to Pliocene V. recta. Use one coiled-to-uncoiled shell, not an extra colony-density variant or an unmarked living species.

sources.title: The Fargo Worm Snail
sources.supports: Names and illustrates Florida Pliocene fossil Vermicularia recta with uncoiled tube-shells; living relatives explain initial regular coiling.
